notes.title: 1.0.010 patch
notes.notes:
· Revamped controls: Now with proper smooth locomotion
· 4K textures: Increased resolution of textures across the board
· New localization: Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese

notes.title: Open SSL startup crash fix
notes.notes: -Fixed bug with OpenSSL that would cause a crash during startup on Intel 11th and 12th Gen CPUs.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed: Quantum Lab laser puzzle bug (sometimes lasers weren't redirecting).
[*] Fixed: Blocker when scanning oniric data drives while flying.
[*] Fixed: Readjusted some trigger volumes in Habitat section.
[/list]

notes.title: Red Matter's Winter Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow comrades!

We've been getting [url=https://vrgamecritic.com/game/red-matter]very high reviews lately.[/url] And now that winter is finally here...

[b]Red Matter's first ever sale is live![/b]

Make sure to tell your friends, your family and your lovely Mushka. There is no better time in the year to travel to the frozen surface of Rhea and explore the abandoned Volgravian base in order to reveal the mysteries that lie behind their top secret research program.

And remember:
Be proud Volgravian, you opened the path to stars!
